verdict.rationale: The developer docs name Canva's plan tiers (Pro, Business, Enterprise) and show some per-feature gating. An MCP/AI-connector tool is marked "Pro and above," and private Connect integrations are limited to Enterprise. This is only a glancing view of tiering inside technical docs, not a published pricing page. Missing for 10: a published pricing page with prices, seat types and per-seat structure, a comprehensive AI-feature gating matrix across plans, and independent corroboration.
